On this plot I will mostly rely on the family’s work and what we can manage with the money we have. For these root crops here in Mwanza, I do not usually buy chemical fertilizer, and I will plant mostly local planting material that I know well. I may use some manure if I can get it, but I will not irrigate, and I do not expect to use pesticide unless there is a serious problem.
